articles.title: Rana House / STUDIO_LPP
articles.summary: In a suburb with little history and no remarkable urban quality, a 1960s subdivision still offered vacant lots for yet another "villa," a housing type that so clearly characterizes these Portuguese outskirts of the big city.

articles.title: Parkside Villa / Studio B Architecture + Interiors
articles.summary: Situated in a rural Boulder neighborhood, Parkside Villa is a comprehensive transformation of an existing 9,100-square-foot residence, reimagined for the evolving lifestyle of an active family. Rather than demolishing and rebuilding, Studio B Architecture + Interiors approached the project as an opportunity to redefine the relationship between architecture, interiors and landscape while preserving the home's existing foundation and much of its structural framing.

articles.title: Neighbourhood Seniors Apartment / DAGA Architects
articles.summary: Beijing's neighborhood elderly apartment is designed to redefine the concept of an old-age apartment in order to change the condition of old and poor, which is 4,500 square meters.

articles.title: Hangzhou Vanke Times Commune / DAGA Architects
articles.summary: The project is located in the west of Xike Netease Science and Technology Park, Binjiang District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province, just one way from Alibaba. The whole building is divided into three parts in a vertical direction, with 1 floor as a shared public service space, 2-6 floors as a joint office space, and 7-15 floors as a rental apartment. Our design task is 1-6 layers of overall space design and 7-15 storey apartment public space design.

articles.title: Beijing Capital Xiangxi Intangible Heritage Workstation / DAGA Architects
articles.summary: The ancient city of Qianzhou on the bank of the Wanrong River has a long history and is known as the first of the four ancient towns in Xiangxi. Today, the ancient city of Qianzhou is not only a cultural window of Xiangxi Prefecture, but also a gathering place for the entire intangible cultural heritage of Xiangxi, with 24 national intangible cultural heritages gathered here. Tiangongju in the ancient city of Qianzhou was originally a place for local carpentry inheritance and practice. It was dedicated to Tiangong Luban. It was an abandoned house before the renovation.

articles.title: Fusion Creative Workshop / ARCHI.DOC
articles.summary: The Faculty of Wood Engineering and Creative Industries building is located in the Botanical Garden of the University of Sopron . The design prioritizes the relationship between old and new, between built space and the natural environment, and the practical, flexible character that a learning space for creative people should have.

articles.title: "From Void to Value: Revisioning Tallinn's Old Town" Vision Competition Exhibition
articles.summary: VISION COMPETITION EXHIBITION The Vision Competition Exhibition, entitled “From Void to Value: Revisioning Tallinn’s Old Town”, is presented at the Tammsaare Park Outdoor Gallery in Tallinn opening on 16 October and running until 12 November 2026. The exhibition presents proposals addressing one of the most contested urban sites in Tallinn’s historic centre: the southern edge of the Old Town, where an unresolved urban void continues to interrupt the connection between the medieval core and the surrounding city. articles.title: Designing Nusantara: The Making of Indonesia's New Capital
articles.summary: What does it take to design a capital city for a culturally diverse nation from the ground up? This book offers a rare, behind-the-scenes look at Nusantara, the new capital of Indonesia, told through the eyes of the lead designer from its earllest conception to its current development. articles.title: Aalok Farmhouse / Nodecraft Studio
articles.summary: Aalok Farmhouse is a 3-bedroom weekend home located on the outskirts of Bengaluru that reinterprets the farmhouse typology through a series of independent pavilions connected by landscape. Rather than treating the outdoors as an extension of the built form, the project allows courtyards, trees and open thresholds to define the architecture. Designed as a retreat for family use and occasional business gatherings, the residence required a balance between privacy and collective interaction. articles.title: Restoring Views at Neutra’s Corwin House with Sky-Frame
articles.summary: About an hour's drive from New York, the Corwin House sits in hilly woodland high above the Saugatuck River. Completed by Richard Neutra in 1956, it is one of only three houses the architect built in Connecticut. Architectural designer Aziz Osko has updated the house , revisiting details from Neutra's original design that were never built.

articles.summary: In Uruguay , small-scale residential projects increasingly occupy rural and coastal landscapes, from the hills of Villa Serrana to the maritime forests along the Atlantic coast.
